intros.description:
I’m an Android Consultant at Deloitte Digital, engineering modern mobile applications using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, backed by a strong foundation in commercial test automation and CI/CD.

In my own time, I design and ship independent projects like FaceDown, a native focus timer app designed to help people stay off their phones.

Outside of tech, I enjoy cooking and unwinding with games - at the moment, that's farming in Stardew Valley.
